notes.title: 🩸 The Dream World Returns + Patch 1.0.3 🩸
notes.notes:
🩸 The Dream World Returns + Patch 1.0.3 🩸  

The story continues 18 years after the events of Siren's Well.
  

A new era of horror awaits: In Siren's Well 2, return to the mysterious town of Siren's Well—now the stage for an all‑new tale. Step into the shoes of two new protagonists as they uncover hidden truths while facing a terrifying, never‑before‑seen threat: the dreadful Crowley Family. 💀
  
[previewyoutube=C6cajDx5yIo;full][/previewyoutube]
🕯 About the Game  

Journey through haunting locations filled with oppressive atmosphere, disturbing mysteries, and twisted fears. Players will confront their own traumas while resisting the sinister influence of the Crowleys, whose presence warps reality and spreads terror throughout the so‑called "town of dreams": Siren's Well. 🌌
  

  

 A completely new standalone narrative – perfect for both newcomers and series veterans  
  

 A plot rich in details, secrets, and hidden connections—just like the previous games  
  

 Two main scenarios with four unique story paths, choices, and consequences  
  

 Female protagonists:  
 — Naomi Chen (Chen Yamei / 陳雅美)  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247490/ae5b49ca5144e6295957c43b86a5d27f9e4f8667.gif
 — Ellie Chen (Chen Yuling / 陳玉玲)  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247490/381848999135c5d096ba2a383b62c3f0f95d7b58.gif

 Fresh antagonist: The Crowley Family, embodying pure psychological terror 👁️ 
  

 Classic horror with a touch of twisted humor inspired by 80s cult films 🎬 
  

 Creative puzzles and impactful decisions 🔑 
  

 Firearms for human enemies 🔫 
  

 Smartphone as a crucial tool in the dream world 📱 
  
  

⚡ Evolution and Expansion of the Universe  

Siren's Well 2 marks the beginning of a brand‑new saga, introducing original characters, a reimagined setting, and subtle connections with past titles—further expanding the dark and immersive Siren’s Well universe. 🕸️
  


Nudity in this game works differently than in previous titles. Now, to reveal a character’s nudity, simply remove the clothes she is wearing. But keep in mind: a completely nude character is much more vulnerable to enemy attacks than one wearing clothes. ^^ 🔥
  


Players will also find clothing items scattered throughout the game environment. Each time you start a "New Game+" playthrough, new clothing pieces will appear in different locations to discover. And that’s not all—there are other surprises waiting for you... 🎁👗
  

WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3999510/Sirens_Well_2/

Patch Notes 1.0.3  
This update focuses on fixing progression and visual consistency issues affecting certain late-game scenarios. Thanks again for reporting these details and helping us refine the experience!  
🛠️ FIXES  
• Fixed the basement (symbolical) door being unintentionally left unlocked during the B-Scenario route.  
• Corrected animation desynchronization during the "Oh Elliot" ending scene, ensuring proper timing and flow.  
💡 NOTES  
• If you were affected by the basement door issue, we recommend restarting from a recent save to ensure scenario progression registers correctly.  
• The ending scene fix does not affect previously saved data — you'll see the corrected animations on any future playthroughs.  
🎯 Version: 1.0.3  
📅 Release Date: September 18, 2025  
Every detail matters in the dark. Keep watching, keep surviving — and keep sending us your feedback. 💀🔑🩸

notes.title: Siren's Well - Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Siren's Well - Patch 1.0.2  
This patch addresses a critical issue that could prevent players from reopening the game after a crash during the final boss fight or the ending credits. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

🛠️ FIXES  
• Fixed a rare crash that occurred after defeating the final boss or during the ending credits, which caused the game to lock and display an "authentication" message on restart.
• Improvements and adjustments to prevent future crashes. (You'll still need an internet connection in order to properly register game actions.)

💡 NOTES  
• After applying this update, we recommend that affected players defeat the final boss again to ensure the game data is properly saved and registered.
• If you haven't encountered this issue, you can safely ignore this update.
• Regarding the internet connection requirement — it's clearly stated on the store page before purchase. By buying the game, players agree to that condition.


🎯 Version: 1.0.2  
📅 Release Date: July 26, 2025

Stay sharp, Survivors. Your feedback is what keeps the nightmare evolving. 💀📷🩸

notes.title: 🩸Siren's Well DEMO 2.0.1 – Hotfix Patch Notes🩸
notes.notes:
🩸
Siren's Well DEMO 2.0.1 – Hotfix Patch Notes
🛠️💀

Hey Survivors! 👋

We’ve just released a small but important hotfix for the DEMO based on the feedback you’ve been sending in. This version brings improvements to the Look Behind camera, hair rendering, and better handling of DLSS technologies.

Let’s break it down:

---

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Visual Improvements

✅ Depth of Field fix – The Look Behind camera will now correctly focus on the character, no more awkward blur when post-processing is set to Epic.
✅ Significantly improved hair rendering inside the House during the opening sequence.
✅ DLSS improvements – Reduced visual artifacting and oversharpening when using DLSS. Should now provide a cleaner experience overall.

---

📌 Reminder

This is a hotfix over the 2.0.0 DEMO.
Make sure your version says 2.0.1 on the main menu screen.

If you're having trouble launching the game, try deleting this file:
C:\Users\youruser\AppData\Local\SirensWell\Saved\SirensWell_PCD3D_SM6.upipelinecache

More fixes and improvements will come with the full release! 🌑
Thanks again for playing!🔦

notes.title: 🩸Siren's Well DEMO 2.0.0 – Update Notes📝🩸
notes.notes:
🩸Siren's Well DEMO 2.0.0 – Update Notes📝🩸

Hello, Survivors! 👋

We’ve made important improvements across the board to enhance your overall experience, based on the feedback many of you generously provided. From combat polish to camera refinements and quality-of-life additions, this update brings us one step closer to the final version of the game.

Let’s take a look at what’s new:

---

🛠️ Bug Fixes, Optimizations & Quality of Life

✅ Optimized all game textures and memory usage for improved performance.
✅ Fixed an issue where the language would reset every time the game was launched.
✅ Updated DLSS from 3.5 to DLSS 4.0.
✅ Added support for DLSS Frame Generation (RTX 40 series only) and NVIDIA Reflex.
✅ Reworked certain NPC appearances to better match the game’s visual tone.
✅ Added optional bloodstains on the player character while in Danger status.
✅ Added Linux support for the shader compiler.
✅ Adjusted and smoothed various cinematics; some cutscene durations were shortened for better pacing.

---

⚔️ Combat & Gameplay Adjustments

🔹 Improved overall movement, camera, and dodge mechanics for a more fluid experience.
🔹 Weapon combat updated: now has a 30% chance to blow off an enemy's head.
🔹 Knife combat improved with smoother animations. (Still not final version.)
🔹 Lowered overall difficulty to offer a more accessible gameplay experience.
🔹 Customizable Controls are now available through the new Keybindings setting.
🔹 Increased the “hotness” of the shower scene for both Scarlett and Ravenna. 🔥
🔹 Relocated the laptop in Ravenna’s journey to improve pacing and exploration.

---

🚨 Important Reminder 🚨

All future bug fixes and feedback will be addressed in the full release.
We’re getting close—your nightmare is only beginning… 🕯️

Make sure you're playing on version 2.0.0, shown at the top of the main menu.
If the game crashes on launch, make sure to delete the %LocalAppData%/SirensWell folder.
Full path: "C:\Users\youruser\AppData\Local\SirensWell".

Thank you for playing, and best of luck out there! 🍀
Please continue to report any issues in the official feedback thread here on the forum.
This DEMO does not represent the final version of the game.

notes.title: 🩸Siren's Well DEMO 1.0.2 - Final Patch Notes 📝🩸
notes.notes:
🩸Siren's Well DEMO 1.0.2 - Final Patch Notes 📝🩸

Hello, Survivors! 👋

This is it! The final update for the Siren’s Well DEMO is here. 🚪🔚  
We’ve made key improvements to the overall experience, addressed important bugs, and refined combat mechanics based on your feedback. From now on, all further adjustments and bug fixes will be implemented in the final version of the game. Let’s dive into what’s new:

---

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Enhancements  
✅ Fixed some Audio Settings issues.  
✅ Fixed blood not spilling from enemies after multiple handgun shots.  
✅ Fixed AI issues with enemies in the Padlock Room (Scarlett’s Scenario).  
✅ Added missing footstep sounds in certain office areas.  

⚔️ Combat & Gameplay Adjustments  
🔹 Added Game Over hints to guide players after death.  
🔹 New music added to Scarlett’s Office scenario for a deeper atmosphere.  
🔹 New Stomping Action hint when an enemy is downed.  
🔹 Enemies now stay on the ground longer after a headshot in Beginner and Easy modes. 
🔹 Amanda Holloway & Dahlia Hemlocke will no longer be taken down by a simple handgun headshot—watch out! 👀  

---

🚨 Important Notice 🚨  
This marks the last update for the DEMO. All future feedback & bug reports will be addressed in the final release of Siren’s Well. Stay tuned, Survivors—your nightmare is just beginning… 🔥  

Make sure you’re on version 1.0.2, displayed at the top of the main menu.  

Thank you for playing, and good luck! 🍀

notes.title: 🩸Siren's Well DEMO 1.0.1 - Patch Notes 📝🩸
notes.notes:
🩸Siren's Well DEMO 1.0.1 - Patch Notes 🩸📝

Hello, Survivors! 👋

We’re excited to bring you another update! This patch includes important improvements, new language support, and voice act enhancements for an even more immersive experience. Here’s what’s new:

Knife Improvements 🔪  
- Now, when interacting with the knife in your inventory, you’ll receive a tip on how to use it effectively. This change is designed to make interactions and gameplay during exploration smoother.

Localization 🌍  
- Added Polish language support to make the game accessible to more players around the world.

Voice Act Improvement 🎙️  
- Reworked all patient notes and medical memos for both characters, making them more dynamic and easier to read, with significant improvements to voice audio.

Bug Fix 🛠️  
- ✅ Fixed the issue that allowed players to reload their pistols after only storing the pistol in the item box while keeping the weapon ammo in their inventory.
- ✅ Fixed the issue that allowed players to walk while lying on the ground.

Remember: Siren's Well is not a combat-focused game. Think carefully before engaging enemies and use your resources wisely to ensure your survival! ⚖️

Didn't notice any difference?
Make sure you’re using version 1.0.1 in the main menu at the top of the screen.

Thank you to all the Survivors for your feedback and support. We are working hard on more updates and improvements. Stay tuned! 🔜

Thank you and good luck!🍀

notes.title: 🩸 Siren’s Well - Demo Update 1.0.082 🩸
notes.notes:
🩸 Siren’s Well - Demo Update 1.0.082 🩸

🛠 Fixes and Improvements:

- 🎮 Fixed the issue preventing players from using the Invert Y-Axis option for both gamepad and keyboard/mouse.
- 💀 Added a new message on the GameOver screen: "YOU ARE DEAD: Return to the main menu to try again..." to clarify confusion, as many players thought this was the end of the demo.
- 🏃‍♀️ Important Note for Survivors: Players who have reached the GameOver screen can keep playing! There's much more to the demo than you might think. The demo will inform you when it’s truly finished, so as long as you don’t see that message, the adventure isn’t over yet!

🧠 A message for you, Survivor:
We know how intense the journey can get, and we’re here to encourage you. Don’t let the GameOver screen fool you—it’s just a pitstop on the road to your victory.  
Keep fighting, Survivor! You’ve got this! 💪🔥

Didn't notice any difference?  
Make sure you’re using version 1.0.082 in the main menu at the top of the screen.

Thank you for playing Siren’s Well and for your continued feedback! 💀👁
